notes: Howard School of Business publishes no MBA class profile statistics: the MBA demographics page shows only concentration percentages, and the MBA program pages give admission requirements (minimum 2 years work experience) but no admitted-class stats; the demographics page directs inquiries to the Office of Graduate Programs by phone. Salary and employment figures are official but from a 2021 university news article about 2020 graduates and are clearly stale. The prior US News tuition figure of 19705 per year is corrected: the official 2026-27 notice lists 19705 as the per-semester Full-Time MBA charge, so the annual figure is 39410.
